words.definition: vt. 通知，告知；报告

examples.en: Please notify the office of any change in your contact details.
examples.zh: 联系方式如有任何变动，请通知办公室。

examples.en: The police were notified within minutes of the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后几分钟内警方就接到了通知。

words.usage: 及物动词、正式用词，搭配 notify sb of sth 或 notify sb that…；比 inform 更公文化，多用于官方告知。派生：notification n. 通知。
collocations: notify sb of sth 通知某人某事
notify the police 报警
be notified in advance 被提前告知
words.mnemonic: not(知道)+ify(使) → 使人知道 → 通知

words.definition: n. 日常饮食；节食；vi. 节食

examples.en: Doctors stress that a balanced diet matters more than any supplement.
examples.zh: 医生强调均衡饮食比任何补品都重要。

examples.en: He went on a strict diet after his annual health check.
examples.zh: 年度体检之后他开始严格节食。

words.usage: 名词，日常饮食；特定的食谱、节食，可数；习语 on a diet 在节食、a balanced diet 均衡饮食；动词义为节食。派生：dietary adj. 饮食的；dietitian n. 营养师。
collocations: a balanced diet 均衡饮食
go on a diet 节食
a high-fiber diet 高纤维饮食
words.mnemonic: 谐音「带饿」→ 带着饿意进食 → 节食

words.definition: vi. 闪耀，闪烁；焕发；n. 火花；活力

examples.en: The lake sparkled in the early morning sun.
examples.zh: 清晨的阳光下湖面波光粼粼。

examples.en: The children's eyes sparkled with excitement at the mention of the trip.
examples.zh: 一提到这次旅行，孩子们的眼睛就闪着兴奋的光。

words.usage: 不及物动词，闪耀、闪闪发光；引申焕发活力：eyes sparkle with joy；名词指火花、光彩、活力。派生：sparkling adj. 闪耀的；起泡的：sparkling water 气泡水。

confusables.note: 洒，撒，词中多 r 与 l

collocations: sparkle in the sunlight 在阳光下闪耀
eyes sparkling with joy 闪着喜悦的双眼
add sparkle to… 给…增添活力
words.mnemonic: spark(火花)+le → 迸出小火花 → 闪耀

words.definition: vt./vi. 口述，听写；命令；支配

examples.en: The manager dictated a reply to his secretary.
examples.zh: 经理向秘书口述了一封回信。

examples.en: Market forces largely dictate the prices of agricultural products.
examples.zh: 农产品价格主要受市场力量支配。

words.usage: 动词多义：口述、使听写：dictate a letter；命令、支配：dictate terms。习语 dictate to sb 发号施令，多用于否定。派生：dictator n. 独裁者。
collocations: dictate a letter 口述信件
dictate terms 发号施令
be dictated by… 由…支配
words.mnemonic: dict(说)+ate → 说了算 → 口述；命令

words.definition: n. 羊群，鸟群；人群；vi. 聚集，蜂拥

examples.en: A flock of sheep grazed lazily on the hillside.
examples.zh: 一群羊在山坡上悠闲地吃草。

examples.en: Thousands of tourists flocked to the coastal town each summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天成千上万的游客涌向这座海滨小镇。

words.usage: 可数名词，兽群、鸟群、人群：a flock of sheep；不及物动词蜂拥：flock to the stadium。谚语 birds of a feather flock together 物以类聚，作文可引用。

confusables.note: 人们，民间的，少一个字母

collocations: a flock of sheep 一群羊
flock to the beaches 涌向海滩
in flocks 成群地
words.mnemonic: f+lock(锁) → 像锁在一起 → 成群；与 folk 一字之差

words.definition: n. 方程式，等式；等同；（多种因素的）平衡

examples.en: Students are required to solve the equation before drawing the graph.
examples.zh: 学生须先解方程再画图。

examples.en: The report criticizes the equation of economic growth with social progress.
examples.zh: 报告批评了把经济增长与社会进步划等号的做法。

words.usage: 名词，方程、等式，数学语境 solve an equation；引申义把…等同：the equation of A with B。派生：equate vt. 使相等；阅读中引申义更常考。
collocations: solve an equation 解方程
a mathematical equation 数学方程
the equation of A with B A与B的等同
words.mnemonic: equ(相等)+ation → 含等号的式子 → 方程式

words.definition: n. 麦克风，话筒

examples.en: The keynote speaker adjusted the microphone before beginning.
examples.zh: 主讲人在开始前调了调麦克风。

examples.en: Reporters pushed their microphones toward the minister as she left.
examples.zh: 部长离开时，记者们把话筒伸向她。

words.usage: 可数名词，麦克风、话筒，口语缩写作 mic 或 mike；speak into the microphone 对着话筒讲。构词 micro 小＋phone 声音，同系列 microscope 显微镜可串记。
collocations: speak into the microphone 对着话筒讲话
a wireless microphone 无线麦克风
grab the microphone 抢过话筒
words.mnemonic: micro(小)+phone(声音) → 收小声音放大 → 话筒

words.definition: vt./vi. 混合，交融；n. 混合物

examples.en: The museum's design blends modern style with local tradition.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆的设计融合了现代风格与本地传统。

examples.en: New students often struggle to blend in with their classmates.
examples.zh: 新学生常常难以融入同学之中。

words.usage: 动词混合、交融，blend in with… 与…融为一体；名词混合物：a blend of tradition and innovation。派生：blender n. 搅拌机；blended adj. 混合的。
collocations: blend in with the surroundings 与环境融为一体
a blend of A and B A与B的混合
blend tradition with innovation 融合传统与创新
words.mnemonic: b+lend(借) → 借来借去混在一起 → 混合

words.definition: adj. 喜剧的，滑稽的；n. 连环画；喜剧演员

examples.en: The comic subplot lightens the film's heavy theme.
examples.zh: 滑稽的次要情节缓和了影片沉重的主题。

examples.en: He began his career drawing comic strips for a local newspaper.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯始于为当地报纸画连环漫画。

words.usage: 形容词，喜剧的、滑稽的，与 tragic 悲剧的相对；名词指连环画、喜剧演员。辨析 comical 侧重滑稽可笑，comic 多指喜剧体裁。派生：comedy n. 喜剧；comedian n. 喜剧演员。
collocations: comic books 连环漫画书
comic effect 喜剧效果
a comic performance 滑稽表演
words.mnemonic: comedy(喜剧)+ic → 喜剧的；与 cosmic 一字之差

words.definition: n. 镇压，压制；（情感等的）压抑

examples.en: The novelist spent his childhood under political repression.
examples.zh: 这位小说家的童年是在政治高压下度过的。

examples.en: Constant repression of anger may harm both mind and body.
examples.zh: 长期压抑愤怒可能对身心都有害。

words.usage: 不可数名词，镇压、压制，多指政治高压，也指情感压抑。搭配 political repression、emotional repression。派生：repress vt. 镇压；repressive adj. 高压的。
collocations: political repression 政治镇压
the repression of emotions 情感压抑
the repression of memories 对记忆的压抑
words.mnemonic: re(回)+press(压)+ion → 压回去 → 镇压；压抑

words.definition: n. 磨坊；工厂；vt. 碾磨

examples.en: The century-old mill still grinds flour for local bakeries.
examples.zh: 这家百年磨坊仍为本地面包房磨制面粉。

examples.en: The paper mill was fined for discharging waste into the river.
examples.zh: 这家造纸厂因向河里排放废水而被罚款。

words.usage: 可数名词，磨坊；轻工业工厂：a paper mill 造纸厂、a cotton mill 纱厂；习语 a millstone round one's neck 沉重负担。派生：miller n. 磨坊主。

synonyms.note: 工厂，多指重工业大型厂

collocations: a cotton mill 纱厂
a paper mill 造纸厂
a millstone round one's neck 沉重的负担
words.mnemonic: 磨坊 mill 磨出的面要运 many miles（形近 mile）

words.definition: n. 听写；口述

examples.en: The secretary spent the morning taking dictation from the director.
examples.zh: 秘书一上午都在记录主任的口述。

examples.en: Our teacher gave us an English dictation at the start of class.
examples.zh: 上课伊始老师给我们做了一次英语听写。

words.usage: 不可数名词，口述、听写：take dictation 记录口述；have a dictation 进行听写测验。与 dictate、dictator 同根 dict 说，可串联记忆，秘书场景常考。
collocations: take dictation 记录口述
have a dictation 进行听写测验
write at sb's dictation 按某人口述写
words.mnemonic: dictate(口述)+ion → 口述记录 → 听写

words.definition: n. 流行性感冒，流感

examples.en: Several colleagues were off work with the flu last week.
examples.zh: 上周有几位同事因流感没来上班。

examples.en: Health officials urged the elderly to get a flu shot before winter.
examples.zh: 卫生官员敦促老年人在入冬前接种流感疫苗。

words.usage: 不可数名词、口语用词，流感，全称 influenza；catch the flu 患流感、a flu shot 流感疫苗、an outbreak of flu 流感爆发。正式或医学语境用 influenza。
collocations: catch the flu 患流感
a flu shot 流感疫苗
an outbreak of flu 流感爆发
words.mnemonic: influenza 的缩略，原义「影响」→ 病毒流行 → 流感

words.definition: n./vt. 羡慕，嫉妒

examples.en: Her language talent is the envy of the whole class.
examples.zh: 她的语言天赋令全班羡慕。

examples.en: I really envy you your freedom to travel whenever you like.
examples.zh: 我真羡慕你想什么时候旅行就什么时候旅行的自由。

words.usage: 名词与动词同形，羡慕、嫉妒；习语 be the envy of sb 令人羡慕、out of envy 出于嫉妒；动词可接双宾。派生：envious adj. 羡慕的；enviable adj. 令人艳羡的。
collocations: out of envy 出于嫉妒
be the envy of sb 令某人羡慕
envy sb their freedom 羡慕某人的自由
words.mnemonic: en(入)+vy(看) → 看进眼里 → 羡慕嫉妒

words.definition: adj. 疼痛的；恼火的；n. 痛处，疮

examples.en: A sore throat kept him awake all night.
examples.zh: 喉咙痛让他一夜未眠。

examples.en: Money is still a sore point between the two brothers.
examples.zh: 钱仍是兄弟俩之间的一个心病。

words.usage: 形容词，疼痛的：a sore throat 喉咙痛；恼火的：be sore about sth；名词指痛处、疮；a sore point 心病、忌讳。派生：sorely adv. 极其：sorely needed 急需。
collocations: a sore throat 喉咙痛
a sore point 心病，忌讳
be sore about sth 对某事恼火
words.mnemonic: sore 押 soar 同音：喉痛 sore，鹰飞 soar，味酸 sour

words.definition: n. 方言，土语

examples.en: The old man told stories in a local dialect that few outsiders understood.
examples.zh: 老人用一种外地人几乎听不懂的方言讲故事。

examples.en: Many local dialects are disappearing as Mandarin becomes dominant.
examples.zh: 随着普通话占据主导，许多地方方言正在消失。

words.usage: 可数名词，方言、土语，是包含语音、词汇、语法差异的语言变体；辨析 accent 口音只是发音差异。搭配 speak in dialect、a local dialect。派生：dialectal adj. 方言的。

confusables.note: 对话，词首 dia- 相同

collocations: speak in dialect 用方言讲话
a local dialect 当地方言
a dialect word 方言词
words.mnemonic: dia(相对)+lect(讲) → 一方水土一方说法 → 方言

words.definition: adj. 宽敞的，广阔的

examples.en: The new apartment is bright and spacious.
examples.zh: 这套新公寓明亮又宽敞。

examples.en: Passengers especially praised the spacious seats on the new trains.
examples.zh: 乘客尤其称赞新车上宽敞的座位。

words.usage: 形容词，宽敞的、广阔的，多形容房屋、房间的内部空间，比较级 more spacious；常与 bright、comfortable 并列修饰 room、apartment。派生：spaciously adv. 宽敞地。

confusables.note: 似是而非的，一字母之差

collocations: a spacious living room 宽敞的客厅
a spacious office 宽敞的办公室
spacious and bright 宽敞明亮
words.mnemonic: spac(e)(空间)+ious → 空间大 → 宽敞

words.definition: adj. 值得注意的，显著的；著名的；n. 名人，要人

examples.en: The study revealed one notable exception to the rule.
examples.zh: 这项研究揭示了这条规律的一个显著例外。

examples.en: She is a notable figure in the field of genetic research.
examples.zh: 她是基因研究领域的一位知名人物。

words.usage: 形容词，值得注意的、显著的：a notable exception；名词指名人、要人。派生：notably adv. 尤其、显著地，阅读插入语高频。注意与 notorious 臭名昭著的感情色彩差别。
collocations: a notable exception 显著的例外
a notable achievement 显著成就
a notable figure 知名人物
words.mnemonic: not(注意)+able(值得) → 值得注意的 → 显著

words.definition: adj. 所谓的，号称的

examples.en: The so-called miracle cure turned out to be a scam.
examples.zh: 这种所谓的神奇疗法结果证明是一场骗局。

examples.en: His so-called friends disappeared when he went bankrupt.
examples.zh: 他那些所谓的朋友在他破产后就消失了。

words.usage: 复合形容词，仅作定语，放名词前；多含贬义或质疑，暗示名不符实；比较 alleged 据称的带法律色彩、supposed 所称的较中性。书面中常给所谓一词加引号使用。

confusables.note: 所谓的，指控的，近义辨析

collocations: the so-called experts 所谓的专家
a so-called friend 所谓的朋友
a so-called democracy 所谓的民主
words.mnemonic: so(如此)+called(被称) → 被这么叫却名不副实 → 所谓的

words.definition: n. 百万富翁；大富翁

examples.en: She became a millionaire at twenty-five by selling her app.
examples.zh: 她二十五岁时靠卖自己的应用软件成了百万富翁。

examples.en: The self-made millionaire donated most of his fortune to rural schools.
examples.zh: 这位白手起家的百万富翁把大部分财产捐给了乡村学校。

words.usage: 可数名词，百万富翁，口语泛指富翁；后缀 -aire 表人，如 billionaire 亿万富翁。搭配 a self-made millionaire 白手起家的富翁。
collocations: a self-made millionaire 白手起家的百万富翁
become a millionaire 成为百万富翁
an overnight millionaire 一夜暴富的富翁
words.mnemonic: million(百万)+aire(人) → 坐拥百万者 → 百万富翁
